name: Home renovation
description: A home renovation paid like a bank construction loan: materials go straight to the supplier, labour is authorized on the homeowner's PayPal and only charged once the work is proven, and 5% stays back for 30 days as a retention for final fixes.

milestones.title: Demolition and strip-out
checklist: Old tiles and sanitary fixtures are removed
Debris is cleared from the room
Walls and floor are stripped back to the substrate

milestones.title: Plumbing and electrics rough-in
checklist: New water pipes are installed and visible before closing the walls
Electrical conduits and junction boxes are fitted
No visible leaks or loose open cables

milestones.title: Electrical installation certificate
checklist: Document is an electrical installation certificate
It is signed or stamped by a registered installer
The installation address is stated on the document

milestones.title: Tiling and finishes
checklist: Walls and floor are fully tiled
Grout lines are finished with no visible gaps
Toilet, basin and shower fixtures are installed
